results.name: Fresh Home has one main landmark, real score preview and no blocking tutorial
Help menu arrow navigation and Escape focus return
Mobile drawer traps focus, returns focus and restores content on Escape
Mobile drawer navigation is clickable above its backdrop and closes on selection
Composer search, difficulty filter, empty results and reset
Library tabs support arrow-key selection and preserve upload access
Featured score opens; playback, Space pause, tempo and metronome respond
Returning Home reopens the same score; F and Escape enter/exit existing focus view
Loop start/end use the current position; enable and clear remain functional
Existing backing track can be muted and restored
Saved score annotations survive leaving, reopening and resizing with unchanged normalized geometry
Existing Wait For You manual advancement and Visual presentation remain reachable
Full tutorial remains available explicitly from Help and can be skipped
Instrument change returns to its own collection; Guitar Home uses real guitar scores

knownLimitations: Inherited playback hook resets tempo/metronome on remount; full session resume requires Phase D persistence work.
Inherited annotation autosave cancels its 600ms timer on unmount; immediate navigation can lose the newest mark despite the unconditional Saved label.
